_meta.what: Reception index: which COF aulas engage which philosopher, with dates. Computed from the PUBLIC community transcription corpus of the Curso Online de Filosofia (585 lectures, 2009-2022); see the cof-transcriptions reference in data/chronology.json.
_meta.method: accent-insensitive word-boundary counts over cof transcriptions; dates joined from cof/index.json; generated 2026-08-02
_meta.traps: Two measurement traps demonstrated on this corpus: (1) accented characters are two bytes in UTF-8 - single-char wildcards silently zero accented names; (2) substring matching inflates - case-insensitive 'Dante' matches comandante/mandante/abundante (407 files vs the true word-boundary 83). All counts here are accent-insensitive AND word-boundary.
_meta.dateCaveat: Dates join from the corpus header dating; ~332 of 589 files carry no verified date. Null date = undated file, not an undated lecture.
